key_insight: Training language models on structured experimental evidence enabled stronger perovskite reasoning and guided a contact-material choice that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI can help prioritize perovskite device experiments, with the selected contact yielding 27.05% efficiency and 96.74% efficiency retention after 1,000 hours at 85°C in dark thermal ageing.
method: Reconstruct expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapt OpenPerov using structured evidence; refine selected passages with retrieval in the Pro version.
Evaluate scientific reasoning and experimentally compare K- and Na-analogue self-assembled monolayer contacts.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; retrieval-assisted Pro increased Scientific Mastery from 87.6 to 89.1.
watch_item: The reported dark thermal ageing result does not establish durability under continuous illumination or outdoor operation.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
